parsed.post: Increased DEPTH to 6 and added WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. val_bpb improved from 1.067257 to 1.059885. Scaling depth seems highly effective. Next, I will try increasing the MATRIX_LR slightly to see if we can push convergence further, as the model seems stable with the current warmup.
parsed.description: Slightly increase MATRIX_LR and introduce a small amount of WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can achieve faster convergence with better regularization.
